objects.name: activity
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "activity" (
        id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        created_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
        actor_name       TEXT,
        actor_email      TEXT,
        actor_kind       TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_source     TEXT,
        actor_session_id TEXT,
        actor_thread_id  TEXT,
        actor_agent      TEXT,
        actor_model      TEXT,
        actor_effort     TEXT,
        entity_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
        entity_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
        action           TEXT NOT NULL,
        changes          TEXT
      )

objects.name: comment
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE comment (
      id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      task_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      number       INTEGER NOT NULL,
      text         TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE (task_id, number)
    )

objects.name: label
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE label (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      description TEXT,
      color TEXT NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: project
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project (
    id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    key         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    task_count  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    archived_at INTEGER)

objects.name: project_column
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_column (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name          TEXT NOT NULL,
    column_order  TEXT)

objects.name: task
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE task (
    id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    column_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_column(id),
    number         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title          TEXT NOT NULL,
    description    TEXT,
    priority       TEXT,
    task_order     TEXT,
    comment_count  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    archived_at    INTEGER)

objects.name: task_label
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_label (
      task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      label_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES label(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      PRIMARY KEY (task_id, label_id)
    )

objects.name: task_relations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_relations (
    id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    source_task_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    target_task_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    relation_type   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at      INTEGER NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE (source_task_id, target_task_id, relation_type),
    CHECK (source_task_id <> target_task_id))

objects.name: task_search
objects.sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE task_search USING fts5(
      task_id UNINDEXED,
      title,
      description,
      comments,
      tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'
    )
